  payload_manifest.qmd — living inventory of every .rds the main and supplement
  consume, with consumers, provenance, status vs the re-run queue, and the source
  generator file. Static columns are maintained by hand from the survey record
  (manuscript/_survey_2026-08/ reports B, D, and the mr_sweep follow-up); the
  metadata columns (Built / Sims / MB) are READ LIVE from the payloads at render,
  so this document self-updates as post-fix payloads land.
  Sections use the post-A4 numbering (reorder of 2026-08-17): apps S6/S7,
  sims S8.1–S8.7, computational details S9.
  This file is NOT part of the submission render set — render standalone:
      quarto render payload_manifest.qmd
  Generator entries were filled by the CC manifest session of 2026-08-17 from repo
  evidence only (payload-export commits cf4d6432/43b051b6, gbsg_redux and gbsg_020
  driver documents, actg175/binary sweep drivers, git --follow provenance) — none
  guessed; paths are forestsearch-repo-relative except where marked.

```{r setup}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
payload_dir <- "_payloads"

read_meta <- function(rel) {
  path <- file.path(payload_dir, rel)
  out <- data.frame(Exists = file.exists(path), Built = NA_character_,
                    Seed = NA_real_, Sims = NA_real_, MB = NA_real_)
  if (!out$Exists) return(out)
  out$MB <- round(file.info(path)$size / 1e6, 2)
  x <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(readRDS(path)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(x) || !is.list(x)) return(out)
  m <- x$meta %||% list()
  b <- x$built %||% x$built_at %||% m$built %||% m$built_at
  if (!is.null(b)) out$Built <- format(as.POSIXct(b), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
  s <- m$seed_base %||% x$seed_base
  if (!is.null(s)) out$Seed <- as.numeric(s)
  ns <- m$n_sims %||% x$n_sims
  if (!is.null(ns)) out$Sims <- as.numeric(ns)
  out
}

manifest_kable <- function(df, cls) {
  knitr::kable(df, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE,
               table.attr = sprintf('class="manifest %s"', cls))
}
```

## Active payloads (consumed by the current render)

Fam: `app` = application table payload · `est.` = t1_t2 estimation bundle ·
`grid` = mr-coverage grid · `knoise` = noise-sweep directory (row points at the
directory's grid; its 21 per-cell bundles share the provenance). `Built`/`Sims`/`MB`
are read live from `_payloads/` at render; a blank `Built` on an existing file
means it embeds no timestamp (true of all legacy `t1_t2` bundles — itself a
provenance finding). `seed_base` is checked live and flagged below only if any
file deviates from 8316951.

```{r table-active}
disp <- active_tbl
disp$Built[disp$Exists & is.na(disp$Built)] <- ""
disp$Built[!disp$Exists] <- "MISSING"
disp$Exists <- NULL; disp$Seed <- NULL
manifest_kable(disp, "active")
```

```{r seed-check, results='asis'}
bad <- active_tbl$Payload[active_tbl$Exists & !is.na(active_tbl$Seed) &
                          active_tbl$Seed != 8316951]
if (length(bad))
  cat("**Seed anomaly - `seed_base` differs from 8316951 in:** ",
      paste0("`", bad, "`", collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Notes

Status and provenance follow the survey record in `_survey_2026-08/` (Report B:
consumption chain and pre-audit classification; Report D + mr_sweep follow-up:
`gbsg_redux` holds nothing newer under old names, post-fix generation =
`quarto/simulations/gbsg_020/` in the `forestsearch` repo, currently fs h10 sims
1–100 only). The audit boundary is 2026-08-06/07 with the MR-denominator fix of
~Aug 5; every live simulation payload above predates it. Unconsumed and archived
payloads (`_payloads/_archive/`, duplicates, `manuscript_legacy/`,
`manuscript_v40/`) are intentionally out of scope here — see Report B §B6.
The three Aug-2 selection-variant sweeps (`effMaxSG` / `effMinSG` / `maxcons`,
h10 knoise0) in `gbsg_redux/mr_sweep/` are new design points with no manuscript
consumer — pre-fix, diagnostic context for the selection-rule decision only.
